design: policy iteration: per lineage s in 0-2, the round-1 CF agent CF/seed_s is the continuation policy (mode) and the actor initialisation of all three arms; critics fresh, paired by seed; same anchors and weights, same hazard seeds as round 1 (HAZARD_SEED0 + anchor_id), same actor stream, losses (bc 0.05), lr, 30,000 updates, evaluation
no_selection: lineages, not the best seed: CF/seed_s -> round2/*/seed_s for every s; nothing chosen after the evaluation

arms.CF: futures regenerated with the lineage agent after the logged torque (one branch per anchor)
arms.CFold: the round-1 futures (branches_cf.npz, generated with the start agent) -- separates regeneration from re-initialisation

comparisons.primary: CF - O per lineage (paired on the common episodes), then over the 3 lineages
comparisons.regeneration: CF - CFold (same agent, same init, futures from the improved vs the start agent)
comparisons.practical: CF - CF1 (the lineage agent itself) and CF - start (the pilot start agent)
comparisons.rule: mean over the 3 paired lineages > 2 x seed s.e. and 3/3; secondary metrics detour / death / timeout / hazard success

held_fixed: everything in notes/MAINLINE_CONTRACT.md sections 2-4 except the continuation agent and the actor initialisation
